title: 15 July 1961: Live: Holyoake Hall, Liverpool
content:
The Beatles performed twice at Holyoake Hall in Wavertree, Liverpool. Their second show there took place one week later, on 22 July 1961.

The Quarrymen also played at Holyoake Hall several times in 1958. The benue is situated opposite the tram sheds on Smithdown Road and is about 200 yards from Penny Lane. It is the closest The Beatles ever played to the famous landmark.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 1984: UK single release: I’m Stepping Out by John Lennon
  • 1974: Recording, editing: Bless You, Surprise Surprise (Sweet Bird Of Paradox), Scared, Move Over Ms L, You Can’t Catch Me, Sweet Little Sixteen by John Lennon

  • 1969: Recording, mixing: You Never Give Me Your Money
  • 1968: Recording, mixing: Revolution, Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da, Cry Baby Cry

  • 1963: Paul McCartney is fined for speeding
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
  • 1958: Julia Lennon dies
